review_notes: Viewed previews/page-0028.png. This page is image-only: mode 'image' with the warning 'OCR unavailable or failed: FzErrorLibrary'. PyMuPDF confirms the page carries no text layer at all - all content is vector paths (713 drawing ops) plus two 16x16 px stray bitmaps, so there is nothing to transcribe and no searchable-text claim is made. The page holds two stacked 1H NMR spectra. I rendered the peak-label strips at 900 dpi to identify them: the top spectrum is labelled 9.30, 9.13, 8.47, 7.93, 7.89, 7.47... which matches the ISM061-18 shift list on page 27 (delta 9.30 (s, 2H), 8.47 (s, 1H), 7.91 ...), and the bottom spectrum is labelled 9.01, 8.41, 7.74, 7.70, 7.53... which matches the ISM061-18-2 list (delta 9.01 (s, 2H), 8.41 (s, 1H), 7.72 ...). Per the review plan I kept the whole page as one image and its original mode rather than splitting it; all ink lies in two bands ([54.7,56.7,463.1,345.7] and [56.7,363.7,463.1,652.7]), both inside the retained full-page crop. Renamed the placeholder asset from 'page-0028' to 'si-nmr-ism061-18-and-ism061-18-2' and gave it a descriptive label so the spectra are findable by text search. LIMITATION TO REPORT: the numeric peak labels and axis values on this page exist only inside the image and are not machine-readable.
